); } const handleStatusChange = (newStatus: 'active' | 'suspended' | 'inactive') => { if (window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to change student status to ${newStatus}?`)) { updateAdmissionStatus(student.id, newStatus as any); } }; const tabs = [ { id: 'bio', label: 'Bio Profile', icon: }, { id: 'academics', label: 'Academics', icon: }, { id: 'attendance', label: 'Attendance', icon: }, { id: 'finance', label: 'Fee Payments', icon: }, ]; return ( {student.status === 'active' || student.status === 'enrolled' ?
